∀ (R : Type u) [inst : Ring.{u} R] (P : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} P] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} R P]
  [Small.{v, u} R],
  Iff (Module.Projective.{u, v} R P)
    (∀ {M : Type v} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{v} M] [inst_5 : Module.{u, v} R M]
      (f : LinearMap.{u, u, v, v} (RingHom.id.{u} R) M P),
      Function.Surjective.{v + 1, v + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{v + 1, v + 1, v + 1} f) →
        Exists.{v + 1} fun g => Eq.{v + 1} (LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, v, v, v} f g) LinearMap.id.{u, v})

∀ (R : Type u) [inst : Ring.{u} R] (P : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} P] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} R P],
  Iff (Module.Projective.{u, v} R P)
    (Exists.{max (u + 2) (v + 2)} fun Q =>
      Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x =>
        Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x_1 =>
          Exists.{0} fun x_2 =>
            Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun i =>
              Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun s =>
                Eq.{v + 1} (LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, v, max u v, v} s i) LinearMap.id.{u, v})

∀ (R : Type u) [inst : Ring.{u} R] (P : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} P] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} R P]
  [Small.{v, u} R],
  Iff (Module.Projective.{u, v} R P)
    (∀ {K M N : Type v} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{v} K] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup.{v} M] [inst_6 : AddCommGroup.{v} N]
      [inst_7 : Module.{u, v} R K] [inst_8 : Module.{u, v} R M] [inst_9 : Module.{u, v} R N]
      (ι : LinearMap.{u, u, v, v} (RingHom.id.{u} R) K M) (π : LinearMap.{u, u, v, v} (RingHom.id.{u} R) M N),
      Function.Injective.{v + 1, v + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{v + 1, v + 1, v + 1} ι) →
        Function.Surjective.{v + 1, v + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{v + 1, v + 1, v + 1} π) →
          Eq.{v + 1} (LinearMap.range.{u, u, v, v} ι) (LinearMap.ker.{u, u, v, v} π) →
            And (Function.Injective.{v + 1, v + 1} fun g => LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, v, v, v} ι g)
              (And
                (∀ (h : LinearMap.{u, u, v, v} (RingHom.id.{u} R) P M),
                  Iff (Eq.{v + 1} (LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, v, v, v} π h) 0)
                    (Exists.{v + 1} fun g => Eq.{v + 1} (LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, v, v, v} ι g) h))
                (Function.Surjective.{v + 1, v + 1} fun h => LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, v, v, v} π h)))
